name: Google Developers Group
tagline: A place where creative minds build impactful technology
imageAlt: GDG On Campus NSUT public profile asset
assetNote: Official chapter branding is linked below. A stable reusable image asset was not established, so this page uses a clearly marked code-symbol fallback.
description: GDG On Campus NSUT is a student-led developer community focused on learning, teaching, peer interaction and building impactful technology. Its public chapter pages describe work across design, coding, development and community-led events.

activities.title: Build & ship
activities.text: Designing websites, applications and community projects with a focus on useful technology.

activities.title: Learn together
activities.text: Peer learning and mentorship across development, DSA, ML, operations and production.

activities.title: Make it a room
activities.text: Workshops, challenges, hackathons and speaker sessions listed through the chapter's public channels.

activities.title: Find your craft
activities.text: A cross-functional chapter structure that includes design, development and community operations.

name: The Debugging Society
imageAlt: The Debugging Society public profile asset
assetNote: The public profile and society website display a logo, but reuse rights and a stable image file were not verified. This page uses a text-and-code fallback.
description: The Debugging Society presents itself as a student-run coding community where students learn, code and compete. Public descriptions emphasize peer knowledge-sharing, data structures, competitive programming and software-development practice.

activities.title: Practice loops
activities.text: Coding assignments, weekly quizzes and deliberate practice around programming fundamentals.

activities.title: Teach the why
activities.text: Peer learning around DSA, competitive programming, C++, Java and development.

activities.title: Compete well
activities.text: Publicly described programming formats include hackathons, coding competitions and tech talks.

activities.title: Prepare forward
activities.text: Interview-preparation and placement-oriented coding practice are part of the public focus.

name: Crescendo
assetNote: The public @crescendonsut profile is linked below. Because a reusable standalone logo file was not verified, the visual uses a music-note fallback rather than an unrelated image.
description: Crescendo is NSUT's student music society, centered on vocal and instrumental performance, collaborative music-making and public-facing campus programming. Its public presence speaks to musicians and music lovers alike.

activities.title: Step on stage
activities.text: Live gigs and stage performances are a visible part of the society's public presence.

activities.title: Jam together
activities.text: Collaborative jam sessions for members who want to make music in a room together.

activities.title: Cover the feeling
activities.text: A public cover series gives vocal and instrumental performers space to share their work.

activities.title: Pitch it up
activities.text: Crescendo has publicly hosted Pitch It Up, a Western group a cappella competition.

name: Ashwamedh
tagline: I chuckle as they laugh, I weep as they cry, I sway as they dance, I feel what they feel
assetNote: The official public profile is linked below, but a stable reusable logo file was not established. A theatre-mask-inspired text fallback keeps the identity expressive without claiming to be the official logo.
description: Ashwamedh is NSUT's dramatics and performing-arts society. Public NSUT and NSUT Alumni descriptions connect it with dramatic expression, acting, character development and stagecraft through rehearsals, workshops and productions.

activities.title: Find the character
activities.text: Rehearsals that build dramatic expression, acting confidence and character development.

activities.title: Make the stage
activities.text: Stagecraft and production thinking for the people who shape how a performance lands.

activities.title: Workshop the work
activities.text: Public descriptions point to workshops and a practice-led approach to performing arts.

activities.title: Tell it live
activities.text: The society's public channels show theatrical productions, stage work and short-form video.

name: DebSoc
tagline: Where raw ideas turn into razor-sharp conviction and opinions turn into real impact
assetNote: The public profile and official university listing are linked below. A stable reusable logo file was not verified, so the fallback uses a typographic debate mark.
description: The Debating Society of NSUT is a university-listed literary society built around debate, deliberation, Model United Nations and related communication activities. Public descriptions show a broad programme spanning competitive speaking, discussion, case-based thinking and writing.

activities.title: Argue with care
activities.text: Parliamentary and conventional debating formats that sharpen speaking and listening.

activities.title: Enter the room
activities.text: Model United Nations and committee-style discussion for people who enjoy perspective-taking.

activities.title: Think in cases
activities.text: Case-study, group-discussion and extempore formats that turn ideas into positions.

activities.title: Make the page
activities.text: Public literary and media programming includes writing, press, visual and online content.

name: Aagaaz
tagline: Where thoughts find rhythm and silence finds meaning.
assetNote: The official public profile and linked channels are listed below. Since a stable reusable logo file was not verified, the page uses a simple typographic fallback.
description: Aagaaz is NSUT's poetry society, focused on building a culture of poetry and giving students a supportive space for literary and personal expression through peer interaction.

activities.title: Write it down
activities.text: A welcoming space for poetry and creative writing in different voices and forms.

activities.title: Say it aloud
activities.text: Spoken-word performances and open-mic formats put language in motion.

activities.title: Gather around words
activities.text: Creative literary sessions and community gatherings make room for listening.

activities.title: Share the page
activities.text: Poetry competitions and recruitment activities connect new writers to the society.
